summary: Unity Global Trading Sdn. Bhd. (Registration Number: SYN-000029) is an active private limited company incorporated on 2018-06-15 within the retail industry, located in Selangor, and engaged in the retail of textiles and baju kurung with a share capital of 250,000. The company is managed by five directors (Director 1, Director 2, Director 3, Director 4, and Director 5) and owned by four shareholders (Director 4 holding 58.25%, Director 5 holding 21.22%, Director 1 holding 12.21%, and Director 3 holding 8.32%). Over the three financial years from 2022 to 2024, the company recorded revenues of 5,130,131 (FY2022), 5,229,803 (FY2023), and 5,352,856 (FY2024), with respective profits after tax of 113,910, 97,951, and 96,805, all audited with unqualified opinions by Audit Firm 8. There are currently no litigation cases recorded against the company.
